diagnosis: The model achieves Top-1 Accuracy = 1.09% and Top-5 Accuracy = 5.94%. Because random chance among 101 classes is 0.99% Top-1 and 4.95% Top-5, the existing checkpoint is confirmed to be severely undertrained (consistent with its recorded 4.0% training accuracy). Without GPU compute to run 20-30 epochs on the 75,750 training images, the local CNN cannot function as an autonomous food classifier.
